description: Order of operations with brackets, of, x, /, + and -

lessons.title: Order Matters
lessons.intro: When a sum has several operations, the ORDER you do them in changes the answer. BODMAS tells us the rule!
explanation: BODMAS: Brackets, Of, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction.
2 + 3 x 4 = 14, because we multiply before we add.
Doing it left to right wrongly would give 20.
lessons.rule: Do multiplication and division before addition and subtraction.
lessons.tip: BODMAS keeps everyone's answer the same.

lessons.title: Multiply Before Add
lessons.intro: The golden first step: handle multiplication and division before addition and subtraction.
lessons.rule: x and / come before + and -.
lessons.tip: Underline the multiply/divide part first.

lessons.title: Divide Before Add
lessons.intro: Division ranks with multiplication — do it before adding or subtracting.
lessons.rule: Division happens before addition.
lessons.tip: Do the division step, then combine.

lessons.title: Left to Right for Equal Rank
lessons.intro: When operations have equal rank, work from left to right.
explanation: x and / are equal rank; + and - are equal rank.
Among equals, go left to right.
lessons.rule: Equal-rank operations: work left to right.
lessons.tip: Never jump around; move left to right.

lessons.title: Order in Real Life
lessons.intro: Shopping sums naturally use order of operations.
lessons.rule: Multiply quantities before adding totals.
lessons.tip: Work out each group cost first.

quiz.question: Riya buys 3 pens at 5 rupees each and 1 book at 20 rupees. What is the total cost in rupees?
quiz.hint: Multiply the pens first, then add the book.

quiz.question: A jar has 2 sweets, then 2 packets of 5 sweets are added. How many sweets in total?
What is 100 - 10 x 5 + 2?
quiz.hint: Multiply first, then left to right.

lessons.title: Brackets First
lessons.intro: Brackets are the boss — whatever is inside them is calculated before anything else.
explanation: The brackets change the order on purpose.
lessons.rule: Do everything inside brackets before the rest.
lessons.tip: Brackets beat even multiplication.

lessons.title: Brackets Change Everything
lessons.intro: The same numbers can give different answers depending on where the brackets go.
explanation: Brackets force the addition to happen first.
lessons.rule: Brackets can completely change the answer.
lessons.tip: Always check for brackets before you start.

lessons.title: Division with Brackets
lessons.intro: Clear the brackets, then divide.
lessons.rule: Brackets first, then divide.
lessons.tip: Never divide before clearing brackets.

lessons.title: Two Sets of Brackets
lessons.intro: When there are two bracketed parts, solve each, then combine.
explanation: Each bracket is handled on its own.
lessons.rule: Solve each bracket separately, then combine.
lessons.tip: Work through brackets one at a time.

lessons.title: Nested Brackets
lessons.intro: Sometimes brackets sit inside brackets — start from the innermost.
lessons.rule: Start with the innermost brackets.
lessons.tip: Peel the brackets from inside out.

quiz.question: A room has (5 + 3) chairs in each of 2 rows. How many chairs in total?

lessons.title: 'Of' Means Multiply
lessons.intro: In BODMAS the 'O' stands for 'of', which simply means multiply — often a fraction of a number.
explanation: Half OF something means multiply by a half.
lessons.rule: 'Of' means multiply and ranks just after brackets.
lessons.tip: Half of 10 is the same as 1/2 x 10.

lessons.title: Division Left to Right
lessons.intro: Division and multiplication share a rank, so do them left to right.
explanation: Divide first because it is on the left.
Do NOT multiply before dividing here.
lessons.rule: Among x and /, go left to right.
lessons.tip: Left operation happens first.

lessons.title: Fractions of Amounts
lessons.intro: Finding a fraction of an amount is an 'of' step in a bigger sum.
lessons.rule: Do the 'of' step before adding or subtracting.
lessons.tip: Quarter of 20 is 5.

lessons.title: Mixing Of and Division
lessons.intro: When 'of' and division appear together, handle them in BODMAS order.
explanation: Left to right among equal ranks.
lessons.rule: 'Of', x and / are handled left to right.
lessons.tip: Treat 'of' as multiply.

lessons.title: Of and Division Master
lessons.intro: Combine 'of' with the other operations confidently.
lessons.rule: Brackets, then 'of', then x/, then +/-.
lessons.tip: Go one BODMAS step at a time.

quiz.question: Half of 18 apples are given away, then 4 more apples are added. How many apples are there now?

lessons.title: Mixing Operations
lessons.intro: Real sums mix adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing. BODMAS keeps them in order.
explanation: Multiply first, then add and subtract left to right.
Follow the BODMAS order every time.
lessons.rule: Do x/ first, then +/- left to right.
lessons.tip: Handle the highest-rank operation first.

lessons.title: Brackets and Division Together
lessons.intro: Combine brackets with division carefully.
explanation: Bracket first, then divide, then add.
lessons.rule: Brackets, then divide, then add.
lessons.tip: Never skip a BODMAS step.

lessons.title: Division Then Multiply
lessons.intro: When a bracket feeds into division and multiplication, go in order.
explanation: Clear the bracket, then left to right.
Divide before multiplying here (it is on the left).
lessons.rule: Bracket first, then x/ left to right.
lessons.tip: Left operation goes first.

lessons.title: Subtract After Dividing
lessons.intro: Division outranks subtraction, so divide first.
explanation: Do both x and / before subtracting.
lessons.rule: Finish all x/ before any +/-.
lessons.tip: Line up the multiply/divide results first.

lessons.title: Mixed Master
lessons.intro: Put every rule together for a full mixed sum.
explanation: Then add and subtract left to right.
lessons.rule: x/ first, then +/-, always left to right.
lessons.tip: Write each step on a new line.

quiz.question: What is 18 / (3 + 3) x 2?
quiz.hint: Bracket first, then left to right.

quiz.question: There are 3 boxes of 4 pencils and 2 boxes of 5 pens. How many items in total?
quiz.hint: Multiply each box group, then add.

lessons.title: Full BODMAS
lessons.intro: Now solve sums that use every part of BODMAS in one go.
lessons.rule: Apply B-O-D-M-A-S in strict order.
lessons.tip: Rewrite the sum after each step.

lessons.title: Repeated Division
lessons.intro: Two divisions in a row are done left to right.
explanation: Bracket first, then divide left to right.
lessons.rule: Chained divisions go left to right.
lessons.tip: Bracket first, then divide twice.

lessons.title: Multiply and Divide Mix
lessons.intro: Combine a bracket, a multiply and a divide.
explanation: Bracket, then x and /, then subtract.
lessons.rule: Brackets, then x/, then +/-.
lessons.tip: Keep the steps separate and neat.

lessons.title: Two Brackets, Full Sum
lessons.intro: Two brackets plus operations — a proper challenge.
explanation: Careful order gives the right answer.
lessons.rule: Clear every bracket before combining.
lessons.tip: Multiply the bracket results last.

lessons.title: BODMAS Master
lessons.intro: You are ready for the toughest order-of-operations sums.
explanation: Take it one careful step at a time.
lessons.rule: Master sums: brackets, x/, then +/- in order.
lessons.tip: Slow and steady beats rushing.

quiz.question: A shop sells 4 toys at 25 rupees each and gives a 10-rupee discount on the total. What is the amount paid in rupees?
quiz.hint: Multiply the toys, then subtract the discount.
